dataList.content:
N Corp.'s courtroom was a stark white chamber drowned in complete silence.
我们抵达了N公司的法庭。那是个纯白而寂寥的地方。
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse
N公司 法庭

dataList.content:
As expected of a place erected for representatives of the law to sit in judgment over criminals, the court of justice was imposing and majestic...
正像是为了审判某人而建一样，虽然那里被建造得十分庄严且宏伟……

Yet that very grandeur made it feel every bit as hollow.
但与此同时却又充斥着几乎同等的空虚。

*sigh* Well, there's no turning back now. Might as well think about what we can actually do.
哎……既然都已经这样了，那还是考虑考虑我们现在能做什么吧。
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse Public Gallery
N公司 法庭旁听席

dataList.content:
We know next to nothing about Meursault's past in N Corp....
就我们而言，我们对默尔索先生居住于N公司时的情况一无所知……

So I say we pay close attention and carefully listen to every word of the proceedings.
所以，首先还是尽可能专注地听听审判内容吧。

Should've pulled answers from the bloke before he got hauled off. The sod never says a word unless you question it out of him.
早知道在那家伙被抓走之前能问多少问多少了。毕竟他是个别人不问就啥都不说的家伙。

Sure, but how were we supposed to know they'd take him away so suddenly?
可是我们都没想过他会突然被抓走……
At the very least... we may safely assume his crime was not a violation of the N Corp. Taboo. 至少……他似乎并未触犯N公司的禁忌。

Right... Otherwise, we would've run into N Corp.'s Taboo Hunters left and right since the very first day we met him.
确实……要是那样，我们第一次见到他的时候就该被N公司的禁忌猎人追着跑了……

Had fortune aligned the hours, perchance we might have beheld the Yellow Harpoon in his Taboo Hunter days here in N Corp.... But alas...
若时期吻合，吾等或许能有幸见到尚是N公司禁忌猎人的蜜黄标枪老爷……

Yeah... and get Yellow Harpooned to death more times than we can count?
……那样一来我们一定会被蜜黄标枪杀死很多很多次吧。

Listening to the Sinners' conversation, I tried to imagine what kind of "crime" Meursault could've committed during his time at N Corp.
我一边听着罪人们聊天，一边思考着默尔索在N公司会犯下怎样的“罪”。

The Meursault we've known so far...
如果是与我们相处至今的默尔索……
... isn't the sort to pick fights with or use violence against other people without justifiable reason, unlike some of us. 他应该不会找谁的麻烦，或是对谁施加暴力。

What're you givin' me that look for, C.H.? You lookin' for a fight?
干嘛用那种让人不爽的眼神看我，钟·头？

Yeah, lookin' for a fight, C.H?
同上。钟·头？

Wait, Heathcliff... have you decided to join in on the abbreviation game too?
啊，希斯克利夫先生也要加入缩略游戏吗？

Ack, what the— It rubbed off on me, bloody hell...!
啊，啥啊？！操，被传染了……

*puff* The start of the C.H. era clocks hard.
呵……这是时代的流向。

Nor is he prone to erratic behavior with blatant disregard for possible consequences...
应该也不会不顾前因后果做出突发行动……

I loathe the notion that Young Meursault could have committed deeds so foul as to warrant a trial...! Though when given orders, he is wont to be the first fist to smite his foes upon their faces, and would fain dislocate their jaw even as, uh, even as they cling to the hem of his breeches, weeping for mercy...
吾等的默尔索定然不会做出多么恶毒之事……当然，若是受命行事，那他必然比任何人都更先一步挥出拳头……即使对方攥紧裤脚痛哭哀求，他亦会毫不留情地击碎那人的下颚……

Hm. Of all the actions taken by our men during the last operation, his alone merits compliment. It was an efficient method of neutralizing the enemy.
没错，那是在先前的作战中唯一值得褒奖的结果。相当高效的压制方式。

Nor is he the type to carry a grudge... like someone I know...
也不像是对谁心怀怨恨……

... Sorry, why are you looking at me? ... Oh.
……为什么看我？啊。

Dante, I can almost see the gears turning in your head, but wild guesses won't get us anywhere right now.
哎……但丁，我大概知道你现在在想什么……

Think about it. If his crime were something normal enough to be guessable, then it wouldn't have resulted in a measure as drastic as permanent exile. So let's get out of our own heads, sit down, and focus on the proceedings.
可如果真能凭推测猜到，那他也不会落得被强制驱逐的下场了吧？

<That's true...>
<好像也是……>

You know what, it still bothers me that you were looking at me while trying to guess what could've sent Meursault to trial... Never mind. Let's just make sure to focus on the proceedings later. 虽然我有点在意为什么我也是推测原因之一……不过算了，还是先把注意力集中到审判上吧。

... Ishmael let out a long breath and returned to watching the commotion past the bar as people prepared to begin the trial.
……以实玛利长叹了一口气，再次看向准备审判的地方。

Something does feel off about him, though. How should I put this...
但还是很不可思议呢，默尔索先生他看上去……

It's almost like he's not even present with the rest of us in this courtroom.
就好像不在这喧嚣的法庭之中似的。

What are ya talkin' about? Meur's standing right over there.
那是什么意思？他不是正正经经地站在那儿呢吗？

Um, yes, he is...
不，唔……虽然确实是站在那里……

But he feels so distant from everyone, like he's here as a spectator to someone else's trial, not as the defendant...
但他比起接受审判的人……更像是在旁观他人的审判一样，有种隔阂感……
Like he's looking somewhere else even though his body is standing here... 就好像他的身体虽然在这里，但却在凝视着别处一样……

<Really? What's a defendant supposed to look like at a normal trial?>
<是吗？一般的审判是什么样的？>

Normal trials, eh? Here's what:
啊，一般的？

Chest puffed, eyes mad-doggin', starin' down the judge like you're sayin' "What're you gonna do about it, wanker?"
不能让自己看上去很怂，所以得全力对着法官那混账昂首挺胸，带着“那咋了！”的态度瞪着对面……

Are you speaking from experience, Heathcliff...? Oh, never mind, actually. I don't even want to know...
难道这是希斯克利夫先生的经验之谈吗……？啊，不对，我不问了……

For the briefest moment...
会有那么一瞬间……

I felt so alone, isolated from every other living soul in all the world.
让我觉得，这世上仿佛只剩下自己一个人。

Everything I'd done, every choice I'd made that I'd believed at the moment was for the best...
在那一瞬间，对那些曾经做过的一切自认为最好的行动……
... was questioned without end. Are you sure that was the best course of action? Can you truly say it wasn't an arbitrary decision on your part? 周围会不断发起质问。那真的是最好的吗，那不是你的独断专行吗。

And somewhere along the way, as you keep trying to justify yourself...
每逢那时，当我不断强调自己没错的时候……

... you realize that your decisions have come back around as consequences, as chains that bind you.
到最后，我才注意到自己作出选择的代价已经在不觉间束缚了我的脚踝。

Outis spoke in a low voice, gazing into the courtroom.
奥提斯一边默默地看着法庭，一边说着。

How do you... How do you cope with something like that?
那……要怎样才能忍受下去呢？

You tell yourself that you were right. Over and over again.
只要一直对自己诉说就好。

You tell yourself that you had no other choice. There was no other choice. Deceive yourself, if you must.
那时候的我……没有其他选择了。即使这只是自我欺骗也无所谓。

... It's no more than a contrivance to keep oneself from stooping and succumbing in the end.
……但那不过是为了防止自我崩溃的方法罢了。

But in this trial, what we ought to be more concerned about is not self-justification, but how the man will carry himself before the judge.
所以，现在反而最应该注意他在法官面前的态度。

What you actually have done... matters less than how convincingly and eloquently you can account for it when you're stood in front of the bench.
比起过去做过什么的事实……如何在法官面前对那作出说明才更加重要。

<*sigh* But he doesn't even have a lawyer to do that for him...>
<哎……连律师都没有，真的没关系吗……>

Please come to order.
肃静。

All rise. The court is now in session, with the honorable judge presiding.
法官即将入席。全员起立。

The spectators all rose to their feet the instant the bailiff finished speaking.
话音刚落，旁听席的人们一同起立。

*groan* Heathcliff... Will you get a move on and get your butt off the chair? They know we're with Meursault. Do you really wanna get on their bad side before the trial even begins?
真是的，希斯克利夫先生。利索点站起来。要是一开始就因为你这副懒散样子被盯上该怎么办。
dataList.place:

N公司 法庭旁听席

dataList.content:
Like I said, lookin' cowed is the worst thing you can do in a courtroom... You act like a scared little bird; they'll pick you clean.
我不是说过不能让对面觉得你很怂吗……要是太利索，可是会被吞掉的。

It wasn't long before three figures, the collars of their suits starched stiff, entered the courtroom.
不一会，三位立着衣领的人进入了法庭。
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse
N公司 法庭

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
You may be seated.
全员就座。

Due to the urgency of the matter, this court has suspended the previously scheduled case hearing to prioritize this emergency session.
由于本案十分紧急，我们暂时推迟了预定处理的审判，即刻开庭。

This will be a summary trial. Unless the defense can prove facts materially inconsistent with the indicted charges, this court will issue a prompt ruling and finish the proceedings within session.
因此，本案将以简易程序进行审理。除非证明此案性质与公诉事实存在出入，否则将快速作出判决并闭庭。

... This bodes ill. They intend to get this fast-tracked.
……不是好兆头啊。意思是要迅速且简洁地结束此事。
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse Public Gallery
N公司 法庭旁听席

dataList.content:
It's always bad when the court is unwilling to devote much time to a case.
看样子法庭并不想在这桩案件上浪费太多时间。

Defendant: Meursault. Registered address: Revoked... Former member of the Maintenance and Management Team at Grand Magasin Sisyphe, once counted among the Ones Who Nail.
被告默尔索。原住址已被注销……曾任职于西西弗百货总部维护管理部门，属于嵌钉者一员。

dataList.content:
Is that correct?
是你本人吗？

Yes, that is correct.
是，没错。

Prosecution and defense counsel—state your appearances for the record.
辩方、检方是否出庭？

For the prosecution, Your Honor.
是，检方发言人在此。

... Defense? Is the defense not present?
……辩方？没有发言人吗？

Has the defendant made no separate arrangements for counsel?
被告，你真的不需要另外准备律师吗？

... We're really going ahead with this without a lawyer?
……真的要在没有律师的情况下开始审判吗？
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse Public Gallery
N公司 法庭旁听席

dataList.content:
And Meursault's expected to... uh, argue his own case?
异议要由那个默尔索先生自己提出？

... The sod barely gets three words out in a day, even with us. Honestly, mate, we'll be lucky if he doesn't just go gruntin', "Mm. Mm." through the whole thing.
……那家伙和我们一起待在巴士上的时候，一天能说到三句话都算是顶天了。但愿他不要全程一直“嗯。嗯。”就好……

Still... remember our cooking contest at K Corp.? Something about that chicken dish seemed to have inspired Meursault to become a veritable orator back then.
啊~不过在K公司吃了鸡肉料理之后，他不是突然变得很能说吗？

I s'pose you're right... One mouthful of that botched slop, and out came every word he'd been saving his whole bloody life...
那……好像是哦？那会可能是他吃了啥不爱吃的，把一辈子能说的话都说完了吧。

Ain't there anything here we can ram down his gob?
……有没有啥吃的能塞进那家伙嘴里啊？

Heathcliff's eyes swiftly scan the room as though he were actually looking for a plate of "botched slop" to feed to Meursault.
希斯克利夫似乎冷静不下来，向四周张望着。

Where exactly do you expect to find food in a courtroom...? And suppose we do—what're you gonna do, lob it into his mouth from here? C'mon, this isn't a cartoon...
在这种地方怎么可能突然弄到食物啊……而且就算弄到了又该怎么扔过去？又不是漫画……

<Wait, where did Faust go?>
<说起来，浮士德去哪儿了……>

Fau? Oh, she's right here—hang on, she was here with me a second ago... Where'd she run off to?
小浮？小浮不就在这……奇怪，刚刚还在边上呢……怎么不见了。

... Could it be that, with the appointed hour arriving, she has gone forth in search of an advocate?
……或许，是想前去寻找律师么？

Would she even have enough time...? I mean, applying for observation alone took forever, so...
真的有时间找吗……？就连我们的旁观申请也花了好一段时间才获批吧。

At this rate, one of us will have to go up there and pretend to be a lawyer.
诶，那也不是不能让咱们中的谁去扮个律师吧？

How could any of us possibly pretend to be a lawyer...? For the last time, this isn't a cartoon...
讨论了半天，结果是让我们假扮律师……怎么可能呢，又不是漫画……

What's with you and cartoons today?
你干嘛一直在漫画来漫画去的？

Hm? If Young Faust be the one thou seekest, why, doth she not stand yonder?
嗯？若是想找浮士德，不就在那儿吗？

Dost thou not see her? There, beside Young Meursault! She standeth proudly beneath the undivided gaze of the courtroom!
看不见吗？正是在默尔索的身边！沐浴众人之目光……

What are you talking about? Why would Faust be...
您在说什么呢。浮士德小姐为什么会在默尔索先生身边……

... standing...
身边……

... next to Meursault...?
为什么真的在他身边啊？

I looked back toward the defendant's seat...
将视线转向被告席后……
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse
N公司 法庭

dataList.content:
... and sure enough, just as Don Quixote had said, Faust was standing beside Meursault...
正如堂吉诃德所说，我们寻找的浮士德就在那里。

... right where it said "Counsel Table."
在默尔索身边……写着“辩方”的牌子前。

Apologies for the tardiness.
很抱歉回复晚了。

Counsel for the defense, Your Honor.
辩方，发言人在此。

<She really is going to be his lawyer...?>
<她真的……要当律师吗？>
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse Public Gallery
N公司 法庭旁听席

dataList.content:
See? Told you the lass had somethin' brewing in that big head of hers.
我说得没错吧，我就说她肯定有想法。

No, you didn't.
你没说过这种话好吗。

I had not thought such a means was within our reach. Perhaps... we may relieve our shoulders of some weight.
我未曾设想此类方式能获得允许……但既然已得到许可，不也算能松一口气了吗。

For in matters of perspicacity... there exists none among us who may eclipse Miss Faust.
浮士德女士……论才智属于我们之中最为优秀的。

Yeah... Having her up there is reassuring, I'll give you that.
你说得对……她可是我们可靠的同伴。

You got this, lass! That prosecutor's got nothin' on you! Lay into that woman 'till she's bleedin'! Metaphorically!
好嘞，狠狠敲打旁边那个混蛋检察官一顿吧。当然不是用拳头而是用嘴啊。

... There remains one concern.
……所以。
What is he doing up there with her? 边上为什么还站着一只像是应激的小猫一样的罪人？

True to Outis's observation,
和奥提斯说的一样。
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse
N公司 法庭

dataList.content:
That was when we saw Sinclair, poking his head out from Faust's side.
辛克莱正端正地站在浮士德旁边。

<... I'm not sure if he knows that himself?>
<……他本人的表情似乎也在询问自己为什么在那儿？>

N Corp. Courthouse Public Gallery

dataList.content:
What treachery is this?! Why should Young Sinclair alone be granted the privilege of commanding the gaze of the entire courtroom?! Aah, it stirreth the bitterest envy within me!
竟然！为何辛克莱也能独占旁听席众人之视线！太令人嫉妒了！

The defense counsel consists of just the two of you, correct?
辩方两名出庭，没错吧。
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse
N公司 法庭

dataList.content:
Err... Yes?
诶……是？

Yes, that is correct.
是，没错。

... Counsel acknowledged.
……已确认。

... I guess "Err, yes?" counts as an acknowledgment?
那也能算是回答的吗。

Prosecution, you may read the indictment.
检方，陈述公诉事实。

The prosecutor opened the case file and began to speak with practiced ease.
被称作检察官的那人展开文件，流畅地说道。

Your Honor. The prosecution shows that the defendant, Meursault, has already stood before this court for causing severe criminal property damage to N Corp.
被告默尔索因涉嫌造成N公司巨大财产损失，已有在本法庭出庭的经历。

<Property damage?>
<财产损失？>
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse Public Gallery
N公司 法庭旁听席

dataList.content:
Y'know... like pickin' a lock to sneak into the backdoor of a shop...
说到财产损失，一般就是……悄悄撬开店铺的后门潜进去之类的……

There's also nickin' carriage wheels. Better if they belong to posh tossers.
或者是把哪个看不顺眼的有钱人家的马车车轮刮花之类的吧。

"Gra-ffi-ti" upon a wall would also fall within that category...
街头涂鸦……似乎是如此称呼。那样在墙上随意涂画也算作损失。

Back home, you'd get off with a lecture or a lil' fine—if it's something small enough to let slide. So it was pretty important to know the neighborhood patrolmen by face.
要是行为比较轻，在我家乡只要口头教育或者罚点款就能解决。所以记住街上治安负责人的脸可是很重要的。

'Course, yours truly was never the one to get caught~ ... <size=70%>Most of the time</size>. The clumsiest and the slowest ones usually ended up holdin' the bag, though. Unfortunate, I know, but that's just how it goes. There's no sense in everyone getting pinched tryina' save that one guy, right?
不过我几乎没被带走过就是啦~通常腿脚最慢、最迟钝的孩子会被抓住呢。虽然对他们很抱歉，不过也是没办法嘛。总不能大家都被抓走吧？

Damn right, lass! You leg it without lookin' back no matter who gets left in the dust. Backstreets rule number one.
那肯定的。不管谁倒下都得头也不回地跑路，这可是后巷的惯例。

The way Heathcliff and Rodya told their stories reminded us, once again, of the large overlap in their past experiences.
希斯克利夫和罗佳两人意气相投地诉说起彼此的经验。

Be that as it may, I should think that to forsake a lagging fellow in such a manner is to forsake one's fellowship...
……但我认为不论何时，关照掉队的友人，与其一同逃跑才是同伴应做之事……

... Because the body's want of swiftness can hardly be laid at the feet of one's resolve.
毕竟身体迟缓难以完全归咎于意志……

Yi Sang, you... uh, been busted before or something?
李箱先生……难道……你被抓过？

But once. It was a day during the years of my reckless youth... when my fellows and I limned a painting on a wall, with the purpose of it being a portrayal of the anguish of difficult times. Little did I know that doing so on private property would prove such a grave offense...
仅那一次。在尚不懂人事的孩童时期……我未经许可将饱含时代烦恼的绘画涂鸦在私有领地的墙壁上，没想到竟会引起那么大的问题……

What...? But isn't offending the law the whole point of doing graffiti? You know, being a rebel and all that stuff?
什么……？可街头涂鸦不就是在明知是错的前提下，带着反抗精神进行的艺术吗？

Nay... I did not know that it was such a thing. Not a single face was marred by guilt as my fellows committed the act. I had thought I was alone in my ignorance of new culture, but...
不……我并不清楚……只是友人们都面容平和地前去，我认定应当也存在那样的文化，只有我一人未曾了解……
Mate... That's what loyalty is. You get caught, you be proud of yourself, 'coz only true friends are willing to take the fall. 喂……那种都是讲究义气。全都是做好了替同伴被抓的觉悟才光明正大过去的。

Perhaps, yet I find it wholly unnecessary that they giggled so merrily as they bolted, leaving me a mournful, fallen form on the ground...
即便如此，他们也不至于一面看着跌倒的我，一面嬉笑着逃跑吧……

Anyways, I'd say Meur still has a chance to skate by with a light sentence if all he did was damage some property~
总之……像财产损失这种说不定意外地能轻松结束呢~

I don't know how many times I've got to make this point, but if all he did was just "damage some property," N Corp. wouldn't have sentenced him to a permanent exile, would they?
但那也没有到要被驱逐的程度吧，我是这么想的。

Oh, ya have a point. Yeah, I wonder why...
啊~对的对的。那到底是因为什么……？

Oi, mate! Just what dodgy shite were you mixed up in before joinin' us?!
喂！你到底在背地里干了啥见不得人的啊！

We're in a courtroom! Lower your voice, imbecile!

Still, this is the first time we've been made to watch one of us getting hanged... 不过……亲眼看人被绞刑还是第一次……

Once the noose was around Meursault's neck, the executioners stepped away. A good distance away.
执行者们从将脖子套进绞绳的默尔索身边离开。

dataList.content:
Only an instant before the hanging did Meursault's gaze meet mine.
在默尔索的脖子被勒紧的前一刻，我终于和台上的默尔索对上了视线。

Perhaps I had imagined it. Or perhaps his gaze simply chanced to rest upon a fragment of an impossibly unfamiliar sight that could only be seen from the scaffold where he was standing.
又或许是我的错觉。默尔索只是恰巧将视线停留在了某片陌生的场景碎片之上。

Meursault's face remained stoic and expressionless to the very last moment.
直到最后，我也没能看到他的表情。

He merely closed his eyes, like a man shielding his vision from the blinding sunlight.
他只是像因太过刺眼而闭目一般。

The rope didn't wait. With a loud click, the machine whirred into motion. The noose pulled Meursault up into the air...
绞刑架的绳索没有丝毫犹豫便将默尔索拉入空中……

And then, it was over.
随后，一切结束了。

It's over.
结束了。

dataList.content:
So... What now? Do we lie in cover somewhere nearby until Manager Bud can bring him back?
之后该……怎么办？先躲在附近，等到合适的时机就让经理兄复活他吗？

No. This is the point where the mission will officially commence.
不，真正的作战从现在开始。

First, the sentencing of Meursault to the Sisyphe Penalty, then his being sent to the gallows.
从宣判西西弗刑开始，到默尔索先生被送上绞刑架。

This was the prerequisite order of events for this mission.
这都是本次作战的准备工作。

... So that's why you sabotaged his case, huh?
……所以，你是故意让默尔索先生陷入不利情况的吗？

Faust gave a light nod. She didn't seem to think it was necessary to even defend herself.
浮士德似乎根本没有否定的意思，轻轻点点头。

... I get that part, but why did you have to bring me along? I seriously thought I was going to burst into tears up there, Faust...
……可为什么要带我过去呢？我真的差点哭出来了，浮士德小姐……

Regarding that... an apology is in order. This step of the preparation required an individual whose presence could... "downgrade" Faust's competence. The exigencies of the situation permitted no alternative.
关于那点……很抱歉。因为必须要一个能对浮士德的才能……进行“削弱”的人，所以迫不得已。

What the hell is that supposed to mean...?
……那是什么意思……

The idea may prove difficult for you to understand, but the deliberate concealment of Faust's unparalleled logical precision and perspicacity is far more arduous than you might think.
对各位而言或许难以理解……但想要刻意隐瞒浮士德优秀的逻辑与明智……比想象中困难得多。

Are you saying... you dragged me out there because me standing next to you would make you seem... less smart?
所以我是，负责让浮士德小姐看上去没那么聪明……的角色吗？

Heathcliff might have been a serviceable candidate for this purpose; however, his instinctive faculties have developed to a rather remarkable degree of late. In extremely rare cases, he has displayed a capability to arrive at insights that even I did not anticipate.
虽然希斯克利夫先生也是不错的选择，但最近希斯克利夫先生的直觉发达得惊人，甚至连我也偶尔无法预料到他的洞察力。

There was also the option of bringing along a Sinner prone to spontaneous and unpredictable actions... But that would have introduced the risk of contempt of court in the worst-case scenario, not only delaying the court proceedings but also subjecting the company to a punitive fine...
不过，如果带一位会做出突发行为的罪人……运气不好或许会被视作藐视法庭。那样一来不仅审判本身会被延后，连我们都可能要被罚款。

Your sacrifice was an indispensable one.
因此这是必要的牺牲。

... I'll G.Y.B. for this...
……记·完。

Heh.
呵。

For what it's worth, Sinc... Ya really took one for the team...
总之辛苦你啦，辛克……

The courtroom was cleared as soon as the execution was completed.
执行刚一结束，便下达了全员闭庭离席的命令。

Fau, do ya know where they're taking Meur's... Taking Meur?
那么小浮，你知道的吧？他们要把默尔……带到哪里去？
